description: Shell script testing the integration of 'git p4' with wildcard filenames in various scenarios such as add, clone, submit, modify, rename, delete, and keyword scrubbing.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a local Perforce server instance for testing.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is an existing file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Asserts the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up git repository after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of testing sequence.
